_doc: Der Kranich as a plane (T-220, the owner's plane pass on Fernflug Act II; docs/MAP4_FERNFLUG.md section 4.10). Presentation only: nothing here collides, nothing is navmesh source, nothing changes a gameplay timing. Map frame: +Z the nose, +X starboard, y up, the deck at y = 0. `hull` (KranichExterior, gravelight/world/map04/kranich_exterior.gd): the outer skin built at load from the planform: le / te are the leading / trailing edge knots [|x|, z] (straight segments, mirrored port and starboard), top / bottom the skin's heights (the upper skin clears every room roof and stays under the wing walk's grating, 3.28 m), le_round / te_round the nose and tail rounding (m), mid_y the leading edge's height, te_top / te_bottom the trailing edge's lips, glass_x the flight-deck glass's half width (no nose rounding in front of it, the glass is the nose), tip_from the span where the tip thins; bumps [x0, z0, x1, z1, height, margin] are the fairings over the rooms, the engines and the window closets (the margin is the rounded shoulder); notch [x0, x1, z_aft, y] lowers the upper skin behind the starboard gun blisters so their gunners see out (starboard only). rows / cols_step: the mesh density. engines: the four impeller nacelles [x] (intake on the leading edge, the fairing on top, the nozzle at the trailing edge, heat shimmer, a dim exhaust glow at night, soot on the skin). paint: the upper camouflage and the night-black underside. markings: stencils on the upper skin [x, z, w, h, atlas cell, rotation deg, colour] from assets/ours/textures/kranich_markings/ (fictional unit code and plain German maintenance stencils; never an emblem where a period plane carried a national one: docs/ART_FACTIONS.md). hatches: crew-sized access hatches [x, z] (real depth, the scale cue). masts: the dorsal aerial mast and the wingtip masts with the aerial wires between them. flutter: tarps, ropes and streamers (a vertex shader; cosmetic). `air` (KranichAir, gravelight/world/map04/kranich_air.gd): exposure: how exposed the listener is (0 inside .. 1 out on the wing) from boxes [lo, hi, e, fade] and the live openings (the bay doors, a blown breach, a decompression), driving the wind roar and the outside engine roar; turbulence: the rare small events (a light camera shake through CameraSway, a rattle, the airframe's groan, a flicker of the nearby lamps, the hangings nudged) every every_s, only in a quiet moment (no boss, no cutscene, no egg holdout, no tilt or decompression or bomb run, no quest step in the last quiet_after_step_s, at most max_near_zombies within near_m, not hurt for hurt_s); bank: the sky, the clouds and the moon/sun bank a few degrees and recover (the world moves, never the floor or the camera); sun: the key light swings from the moon to the dawn sun behind the wing as the act's sunrise rises; cloud_banks: a cloud bank streaming through and over the wing now and then (billboard puffs plus a fog volume).

legibility._doc: T-220 b: what makes the skin read from the catwalk at night: a cold sky fill on the hull's own render layer (fill_night .. fill_dawn energy, from fill_from, extra specular so the panels shine), the non-skid strips st_pad m round the catwalk's segments and the walk-limit line st_line m out (st_line_w wide, line_color), the seams' darkness, the wingtip strobes (a double flash every strobe_period_s), the nozzles' glow sprites.

clouds._doc: T-220 b: the sheets below lit brighter on top (FlightSky cloud_layer lit_color), so the deck reads through the gaps at night

golden._doc: T-221: the golden hour of the bomb run (KranichSunset, gravelight/world/map04/kranich_sunset.gd). The act's own clock runs night -> dawn (MapAmbience flight_sun, FlightSky.sunrise up to dawn_max); golden rises from from_sunrise to to_sunrise (act round 4 into 5) and is held at run_hold while the bomb run is on (eased over run_ease_s). It reads as a sunset on screen; in the story it is still the dawn behind the wing. key_*: the key light (the act's DirectionalLight Moon) deepened to gold, brighter, glinting, laid low at sun_dir (toward the sun: aft, a few degrees up). clouds: the sheets below lit / shadowed. bay: the ramp seam's low sun shaft (a shadowed spot: god rays through the racks in the volumetric fog) at energy x golden while the run or the bay doors are on (idle share otherwise), the dust motes; hatch_hold_s: how long a dropped rack's release hatch glows. drop: the casing under the hull (from_y), its aft drift (m/s2), vapour until cloud_y, gone after life_s; a live (not dud) casing ends in a violet flash flash_m wide at flash_y, flash_back m aft, after flash_after_s.

interior._doc: T-221: the interior made readable (KranichInterior, gravelight/world/map04/kranich_interior.gd): lamps [x, y, z, kind, zone] of the kinds (colour, energy off = before the aux bus / on = after, range, fog, bare = no fixture mesh, flicker), none shadowed; zone_scale: the generator's lights per zone x [energy, range]; subfloors [x0, z0, x1, z1, y]: dark plates under the walkway gratings.
